observation: Actual whole durable original PNG opened independently at original resolution once before authoring. No old modern artwork, answer key or repeated source/science gate used.
sourceFacts: One qualitative p-V plot, upward pressure arrow, rightward volume arrow, origin 0. Source has no numeric ticks, units or calibrated readings.
Named points C and K lie on one solid critical isotherm. Its CK segment falls steeply toward K; the solid right branch continues down/right to one finite unlabelled endpoint.
The dashed saturated-liquid endpoint boundary AK runs from A on the volume axis to K. The dashed saturated-vapor endpoint boundary BK runs from K to B on the volume axis. A lies left of B.
The two dashed curves enclose one coexistence region, vertically hatched, with the source label Liquid and saturated vapor.
The liquid region is horizontally hatched: left of AK below K and to the left/below CK in the source fluid diagram. Its left boundary is the pressure axis.
The unsaturated-vapor region is diagonally hatched below the right critical-isotherm branch and to the right of BK; its lower boundary is the volume axis.
The Gas region is dotted above the solid critical isotherm. The upper and right ends of the dots are texture terminations, not printed solid frame borders.
Source Chinese labels are liquid, liquid and saturated vapor, unsaturated vapor and gas. Math point labels A, B, C, K and axis labels p, V, 0 are retained.

Horizontal, vertical, diagonal and dotted marks identify regions; they are neither molecular counts nor calibrated grids. No solid-state region, extra isotherm, temperature reading or additional process arrow is printed.
